name: Sawanaga Miki
source:
Midori's bestfriend who was also Kei's former classmate last year even though they never talked. A lively sport girl who belonged to the basketball club. Famous among the girls for her boyish personality and hardly get along with Ryouka.

She is the older sister of Sawanaga Taisuke from School Days and the daughter of Inou Ayumu from Large PonPon.
